intro: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for Class IX (9th) & XI (11th) Lateral Entry Admission 2026-27. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to NVS LE Admission. Online Apply Start On September 2, 2026 & Last Date for Application is September 30, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.

Online Apply Start On : 02 September 2026

Residency & Academic Status: Candidates must be bonafide residents of the concerned district and studying in Class VIII during Academic Session 2026-27 in a Govt. or Govt. Recognized School located in the same district where Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV) is functional.
District Criteria: The candidate's district of residence and district of Class VIII study must be the same for session 2027-28 admission.
Category Relaxation: The age criteria apply equally to all categories, including SC, ST, OBC, and Divyang (PwD) candidates.

Academic Status: Candidates must be actively studying in Class X during the 2026-27 academic session in a Govt. or Govt. recognized school (CBSE, State Board, or other recognized boards) in the same district as the JNV.
Ineligibility Rule: Students who passed Class X prior to the 2026-27 session are not eligible to apply.
Category Norms: The age limit applies uniformly to all candidate categories, including Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST).
Class IX: Date of Birth must fall between 1st May 2012 and 31st July 2014 (both dates inclusive).
Class XI: Date of Birth must fall between 1st June 2010 and 31st July 2012 (both dates inclusive).
Class 9: Bonafide resident of the same district. Studying in Class VIII in 2026-27 in Govt. / Govt. Recognized school of that district where JNV is functional.
Class 11: Studying in Class X in 2026-27 in Govt. / Govt. Recognized school (CBSE / State Board) of the same district. Class X already passed students eligible nahi hain.
Class 9 Age: Born between 01 May 2012 and 31 July 2014
Class 11 Age: Born between 01 June 2010 and 31 July 2012
Total Seats: 665

Class 9 and Class 11 both open
